entries.1098ca0025ba6cfe: Its basic operating policy is to aim for both 'contribution to a sustainable society' and 'sustainable enhancement of corporate value' by providing high-value-added rental services as a one-stop coordinator that creates new value. Its key measures include increasing rental assets, optimizing rental prices and improving utilization rates; strengthening Value Plus Services and developing new fields; building networks in urban areas and expanding market share; forming alliances with peer companies and strengthening and expanding domestic and overseas group functions; expanding overseas rental business centered on Thailand; and business reform using digital and AI.

entries.3db8c3ff89d20fc8: The growth pillars are developing the rental market for industries outside construction, expanding value-added services, and growing the business in ASEAN. As a result of continuing to propose 'rent rather than own' to industries where rental use has not progressed, customers outside the construction industry make up about 61% of rental sales, and sales related to Value Plus Services have grown to ¥7,702 million. Overseas, it is strengthening its base in Thailand and establishing earnings bases in Vietnam and Indonesia.
entries.40c595adf3dd1ac1: The company is headquartered in Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture, and forms a group of 12 companies in total: the company, 8 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended May 2026 numbered 1,752, and the company was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market in June 2025.
entries.46e75d00c01f3812: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥2,901 million. For the previous consolidated fiscal year it was ¥2,498 million.
entries.540e62551fcb09f0: This is the group's only reportable segment. It provides approximately 7,000 types and more than 660,000 units of rental assets (ownership ratio by category: vehicles 28%, aerial work vehicles and machinery 23%, excavators and road paving machinery 16%, lifting and transport machinery 11%, generators, compressors and environmental products 10%, tools and electrical and surveying equipment 6%, lighting, safety equipment and materials 6%) from the company's 69 domestic sales offices and from subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam. Approximately 61% of rental revenue comes from customers outside the construction industry. Within the group, Rent Sogo Service Co., Ltd., Atex Co., Ltd. and Max Line Co., Ltd. handle delivery of rental assets, Sanko Tosou Bankin Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Kanagawa Sekiyu Hanbai Co., Ltd. handle maintenance and repairs, and Rent Trade & Service Co., Ltd. in Thailand handles procurement and delivery and the dispatch of machine operators.
